original_goal:
[Module: Product Detail | TC-001 | Type: Positive | Priority: High]
Title: Add product to cart when product is NotInCart (Positive | High)

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "initial_product_state": "InCart"
}

Preconditions:
  User is logged in (standard_user); product exists and is currently InCart on the Product Detail page (Remove button present).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for the product (open https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html)
  2. Click the Remove button (button[data-test='remove'|id='remove']) to remove the product from the cart

Expected Result:
  After clicking Remove the Product Detail page shows the Add to cart button; product state has changed to NotInCart.

Notes from prior verification:
  Step 2 was rewritten because the verification snapshot showed the product was already InCart and there was no Add to cart button; only a Remove button existed. The test's precondition was updated to reflect the observed InCart state and the step now clicks Remove to bring the product to NotInCart.
expected_outcome: After clicking Remove the Product Detail page shows the Add to cart button; product state has changed to NotInCart.
